name.local: ビヨンドネクストベンチャーズ株式会社

aum.raw: 約480億円 (approx. ¥48 billion) across three fund vehicles

strategy.thesis: Deep-tech/life-science specialist VC that builds an ecosystem (accelerator programs, shared wet-lab space at Beyond BioLAB TOKYO, the BRAVE researcher-commercialization program) around Japanese university-originated biotech and medtech spinouts, with an investment team that includes MD and PhD principals.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operates Beyond BioLAB TOKYO, a shared wet-lab facility in Nihonbashi for portfolio biotech startups, and the BRAVE program which has moved 200+ researchers toward commercialization, producing roughly 60 new companies as of the program's cumulative count.

people.name: Akito Arima

summary.en: Tokyo-based deep-tech VC founded in 2014 with a life-science/biotech specialization; runs its own wet-lab incubator (Beyond BioLAB TOKYO) and the BRAVE researcher-to-founder program, managing roughly ¥48 billion across its fund vehicles.

name.local: SMBCベンチャーキャピタル株式会社

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned venture capital subsidiary of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation / SMFG; sector-agnostic generalist investor with over 20 years of venture investing and a life-sciences book that the firm states makes up roughly 11% of total investments, spanning regenerative medicine, AI drug discovery, CRO/preclinical services and primary-care services, with multiple IPO exits in the sector.

summary.en: Corporate venture arm of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMFG), a generalist Japanese VC with over two decades of investing whose life-sciences book (~11% of the portfolio) has produced a long run of biotech/medtech IPOs including Heartseed, Chordia Therapeutics and SanBio.
summary.local: 三井住友銀行（SMFGグループ）系のCVC。20年以上の投資実績を持つセクター横断型VCで、ライフサイエンス領域（投資全体の約11%）からHeartseed、Chordia Therapeutics、SanBioなど多数のIPOを輩出。
